```{pyodide}
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", message=".*tight_layout.*")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "monospace",
    "font.size": 13,
    "figure.facecolor": "#fafafa",
    "figure.dpi": 120,
    "savefig.dpi": 120,
})

COLORS = {
    "match": "#4CAF50",
    "mismatch": "#F44336",
    "current": "#FFC107",
    "skip": "#90CAF9",
    "default": "#E0E0E0",
    "pattern": "#BBDEFB",
    "border": "#7E57C2",
}


def draw_string_row(ax, y, string, label="", highlights=None, offset=0):
    """Draw a row of character boxes at vertical position y."""
    highlights = highlights or {}
    for i, ch in enumerate(string):
        color = highlights.get(i, COLORS["default"])
        rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
            (i + offset, y), 0.9, 0.9,
            boxstyle="round,pad=0.05",
            facecolor=color, edgecolor="#555", linewidth=1.2,
        )
        ax.add_patch(rect)
        ax.text(i + offset + 0.45, y + 0.45, ch,
                ha="center", va="center", fontsize=14, fontweight="bold")
    if label:
        ax.text(offset - 0.3, y + 0.45, label,
                ha="right", va="center", fontsize=12, color="#555")
```

## Building the Keyword Tree

Enter a comma-separated list of patterns and see the resulting keyword tree.
The stats panel shows size (number of edges), height (longest pattern),
and maximum fan-out.

```{pyodide}
#| autorun: true
#| edit: false
#| output: false

import networkx as nx


def hierarchy_pos(G, root="root", width=2.0, vert_gap=1.0):
    """Position nodes in a top-down tree layout (pure Python, no graphviz)."""
    def _subtree_width(node):
        children = list(G.successors(node))
        if not children:
            return 1
        return sum(_subtree_width(c) for c in children)

    def _assign(node, left, right, depth, pos):
        pos[node] = ((left + right) / 2, -depth * vert_gap)
        children = sorted(G.successors(node))
        if not children:
            return
        total_w = sum(_subtree_width(c) for c in children)
        x = left
        for child in children:
            w = _subtree_width(child)
            child_right = x + (right - left) * w / total_w
            _assign(child, x, child_right, depth + 1, pos)
            x = child_right

    pos = {}
    _assign(root, 0, width, 0, pos)
    return pos


def build_keyword_tree(patterns):
    """Build a keyword tree as a networkx DiGraph from a list of patterns."""
    G = nx.DiGraph()
    G.add_node("root", label="", depth=0)
    for idx, P in enumerate(patterns):
        cur = "root"
        for j, ch in enumerate(P):
            # Check if edge with this label already exists
            nxt = None
            for _, neighbor, data in G.out_edges(cur, data=True):
                if data["label"] == ch:
                    nxt = neighbor
                    break
            if nxt is None:
                name = f"{cur}_{ch}"
                # Avoid collisions by appending index if needed
                while name in G.nodes:
                    name = name + "'"
                is_leaf = (j == len(P) - 1)
                node_label = P if is_leaf else ""
                G.add_node(name, label=node_label, is_leaf=is_leaf,
                           depth=j + 1, pattern=P if is_leaf else "")
                G.add_edge(cur, name, label=ch)
                cur = name
            else:
                cur = nxt
                # If this is the last character, mark as leaf too
                if j == len(P) - 1:
                    G.nodes[cur]["is_leaf"] = True
                    G.nodes[cur]["label"] = P
                    G.nodes[cur]["pattern"] = P
    return G


def draw_keyword_tree(G, patterns, title=""):
    """Draw keyword tree with stats panel."""
    n_edges = G.number_of_edges()
    depths = [G.nodes[n].get("depth", 0) for n in G.nodes]
    height = max(depths) if depths else 0
    fan_outs = [G.out_degree(n) for n in G.nodes]
    max_fan = max(fan_outs) if fan_outs else 0

    fig, (ax, ax_stats) = plt.subplots(
        1, 2, figsize=(max(len(G.nodes) * 0.7, 8), max(height * 1.1, 4)),
        gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": [3, 1]})

    # Draw tree
    pos = hierarchy_pos(G, root="root", width=max(len(G.nodes) * 0.3, 2.0))

    leaves = [n for n in G.nodes if G.nodes[n].get("is_leaf", False)]
    internals = [n for n in G.nodes if n not in leaves]

    nx.draw_networkx_nodes(G, pos, nodelist=internals, ax=ax,
                           node_color="#BBDEFB", node_size=400, edgecolors="#555")
    nx.draw_networkx_nodes(G, pos, nodelist=leaves, ax=ax,
                           node_color="#FFCC80", node_size=400, edgecolors="#E65100",
                           linewidths=2.0)

    nx.draw_networkx_edges(G, pos, ax=ax, edge_color="#777",
                           arrows=True, arrowsize=12, width=1.5)

    edge_labels = {(u, v): d["label"] for u, v, d in G.edges(data=True)}
    nx.draw_networkx_edge_labels(G, pos, edge_labels=edge_labels, ax=ax,
                                  font_size=12, font_color="#9C27B0",
                                  font_family="monospace")

    # Leaf labels (pattern names below leaves)
    for n in leaves:
        x, y = pos[n]
        pat = G.nodes[n].get("pattern", "")
        if pat:
            ax.text(x, y - 0.35, pat, ha="center", va="top",
                    fontsize=9, fontstyle="italic", color="#E65100",
                    fontfamily="monospace")

    # Root label
    rx, ry = pos["root"]
    ax.text(rx, ry + 0.3, "root", ha="center", va="bottom",
            fontsize=9, color="#999")

    ax.set_title(title or "Keyword Tree", fontsize=13, pad=12)
    ax.axis("off")

    # Stats panel
    ax_stats.axis("off")
    stats_text = (
        f"Patterns:  {len(patterns)}\n\n"
        f"Size (edges):  {n_edges}\n\n"
        f"Height:  {height}\n\n"
        f"Max fan-out:  {max_fan}\n\n"
        f"Σ |Pᵢ| = {sum(len(p) for p in patterns)}"
    )
    ax_stats.text(0.1, 0.7, stats_text, fontsize=12, fontfamily="monospace",
                  va="top", ha="left",
                  bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.5", facecolor="#F5F5F5",
                            edgecolor="#CCC"))
    ax_stats.set_title("Stats", fontsize=13, pad=12)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

## Searching with the Keyword Tree

Enter a text and patterns. Step through each starting position to see
the descent from the root: active edges light up, non-matching branches
are grayed out.

```{pyodide}
#| autorun: true
#| edit: false
#| output: false

def keyword_search_trace(T, patterns):
    """Trace the keyword-tree search: one step per starting position s.
    Returns list of (s, path_edges, matched_pattern_or_None)."""
    G = build_keyword_tree(patterns)
    steps = []
    for s in range(len(T)):
        cur = "root"
        path_edges = []
        matched = None
        for j in range(s, len(T)):
            ch = T[j]
            nxt = None
            for _, neighbor, data in G.out_edges(cur, data=True):
                if data["label"] == ch:
                    nxt = neighbor
                    path_edges.append((cur, neighbor))
                    break
            if nxt is None:
                break  # mismatch
            cur = nxt
            if G.nodes[cur].get("is_leaf", False):
                matched = G.nodes[cur].get("pattern", "")
                break
        steps.append((s, path_edges, matched))
    return G, steps


def draw_keyword_search_step(T, G, steps, step_idx):
    """Draw one step of keyword-tree search over T."""
    s, path_edges, matched = steps[step_idx]
    path_edge_set = set(path_edges)
    path_node_set = {"root"}
    for u, v in path_edges:
        path_node_set.add(u)
        path_node_set.add(v)

    matches_so_far = [(st[0], st[2]) for st in steps[:step_idx + 1] if st[2]]

    fig, (ax_text, ax_tree) = plt.subplots(
        2, 1, figsize=(max(len(T) * 0.85, 10), max(len(G.nodes) * 0.4, 5)),
        gridspec_kw={"height_ratios": [1, 3]})

    # ── Text row ──
    ax_text.set_xlim(-2.5, len(T) + 1.5)
    ax_text.set_ylim(-0.5, 2.5)
    ax_text.set_aspect("equal")
    ax_text.axis("off")

    for i in range(len(T)):
        ax_text.text(i + 0.45, 2.2, str(i), ha="center", va="center",
                     fontsize=9, color="#999")

    depth_reached = len(path_edges)
    t_hi = {}
    for j in range(len(T)):
        if j == s and depth_reached == 0:
            t_hi[j] = COLORS["mismatch"]
        elif s <= j < s + depth_reached:
            t_hi[j] = COLORS["match"] if matched else COLORS["current"]
        elif j == s + depth_reached and not matched and depth_reached > 0:
            t_hi[j] = COLORS["mismatch"]

    draw_string_row(ax_text, 0.8, T, label="T", highlights=t_hi)

    # Pointer for current s
    ax_text.annotate("s=" + str(s), xy=(s + 0.45, 0.8),
                     xytext=(s + 0.45, 0.15), fontsize=10, color="#555",
                     ha="center", fontweight="bold",
                     arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color="#555", lw=1.5))

    if matched:
        status = f'MATCH: "{matched}" at position {s}'
        ax_text.text(len(T) + 0.5, 1.2, status, fontsize=10,
                     color=COLORS["match"], va="center", fontweight="bold")
    elif depth_reached == 0:
        ax_text.text(len(T) + 0.5, 1.2,
                     f"no edge for '{T[s]}'" if s < len(T) else "",
                     fontsize=10, color=COLORS["mismatch"], va="center")
    else:
        mismatch_pos = s + depth_reached
        if mismatch_pos < len(T):
            ax_text.text(len(T) + 0.5, 1.2,
                         f"stuck at '{T[mismatch_pos]}'",
                         fontsize=10, color=COLORS["mismatch"], va="center")

    ax_text.set_title(
        f"Step {step_idx + 1}/{len(steps)}  |  "
        f"matches found: {len(matches_so_far)}",
        fontsize=11, pad=8)

    # ── Tree ──
    pos = hierarchy_pos(G, root="root", width=max(len(G.nodes) * 0.3, 2.0))

    # Classify nodes
    active_internals = [n for n in G.nodes if n in path_node_set
                        and not G.nodes[n].get("is_leaf", False)]
    active_leaves = [n for n in G.nodes if n in path_node_set
                     and G.nodes[n].get("is_leaf", False)]
    dim_internals = [n for n in G.nodes if n not in path_node_set
                     and not G.nodes[n].get("is_leaf", False)]
    dim_leaves = [n for n in G.nodes if n not in path_node_set
                  and G.nodes[n].get("is_leaf", False)]

    # Dim nodes
    if dim_internals:
        nx.draw_networkx_nodes(G, pos, nodelist=dim_internals, ax=ax_tree,
                               node_color="#E8E8E8", node_size=350,
                               edgecolors="#CCC", alpha=0.4)
    if dim_leaves:
        nx.draw_networkx_nodes(G, pos, nodelist=dim_leaves, ax=ax_tree,
                               node_color="#F0E0D0", node_size=350,
                               edgecolors="#CCC", linewidths=1.5, alpha=0.4)

    # Active nodes
    if active_internals:
        nx.draw_networkx_nodes(G, pos, nodelist=active_internals, ax=ax_tree,
                               node_color="#BBDEFB", node_size=450,
                               edgecolors="#1565C0", linewidths=2.0)
    if active_leaves:
        match_color = "#66BB6A" if matched else "#FFCC80"
        edge_color = "#2E7D32" if matched else "#E65100"
        nx.draw_networkx_nodes(G, pos, nodelist=active_leaves, ax=ax_tree,
                               node_color=match_color, node_size=450,
                               edgecolors=edge_color, linewidths=2.5)

    # Dim edges
    dim_edges = [(u, v) for u, v in G.edges() if (u, v) not in path_edge_set]
    if dim_edges:
        nx.draw_networkx_edges(G, pos, edgelist=dim_edges, ax=ax_tree,
                               edge_color="#DDD", arrows=True, arrowsize=10,
                               width=1.0, alpha=0.4)

    # Active edges
    if path_edges:
        edge_c = COLORS["match"] if matched else "#1565C0"
        nx.draw_networkx_edges(G, pos, edgelist=path_edges, ax=ax_tree,
                               edge_color=edge_c, arrows=True, arrowsize=14,
                               width=3.0)

    # Edge labels: active bold, dim faded
    active_elabels = {(u, v): d["label"] for u, v, d in G.edges(data=True)
                      if (u, v) in path_edge_set}
    dim_elabels = {(u, v): d["label"] for u, v, d in G.edges(data=True)
                   if (u, v) not in path_edge_set}

    if dim_elabels:
        nx.draw_networkx_edge_labels(G, pos, edge_labels=dim_elabels,
                                      ax=ax_tree, font_size=10,
                                      font_color="#CCC",
                                      font_family="monospace")
    if active_elabels:
        nx.draw_networkx_edge_labels(G, pos, edge_labels=active_elabels,
                                      ax=ax_tree, font_size=13,
                                      font_color="#9C27B0",
                                      font_family="monospace",
                                      font_weight="bold")

    # Leaf pattern labels
    for n in G.nodes:
        if G.nodes[n].get("is_leaf", False):
            x, y = pos[n]
            pat = G.nodes[n].get("pattern", "")
            if pat:
                alpha = 1.0 if n in path_node_set else 0.35
                ax_tree.text(x, y - 0.35, pat, ha="center", va="top",
                             fontsize=9, fontstyle="italic",
                             color="#E65100", fontfamily="monospace",
                             alpha=alpha)

    # Root label
    rx, ry = pos["root"]
    ax_tree.text(rx, ry + 0.3, "root", ha="center", va="bottom",
                 fontsize=9, color="#999")

    ax_tree.axis("off")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

## Aho-Corasick: Failure Links & Output Links

The keyword tree alone restarts from the root at every position.
The **Aho-Corasick automaton** adds two types of pointers:

- **Failure links** (red dashed): when the descent gets stuck, jump to the longest proper suffix of the current path that is also a prefix of some pattern.
- **Output links** (green dotted): chain together all patterns that end along the failure-link path, so patterns ending at internal nodes are not missed.

```{pyodide}
#| autorun: true
#| edit: false
#| output: false

def compute_failure_links(G):
    """Compute failure links for keyword tree G using BFS."""
    from collections import deque
    fail = {}
    fail["root"] = "root"

    # Map each node to the string it represents
    node_string = {"root": ""}
    for n in nx.topological_sort(G):
        if n == "root":
            continue
        for parent, child, data in G.in_edges(n, data=True):
            node_string[n] = node_string[parent] + data["label"]

    # BFS by depth
    queue = deque()
    for _, child, data in G.out_edges("root", data=True):
        fail[child] = "root"
        queue.append(child)

    while queue:
        v = queue.popleft()
        for _, child, data in G.out_edges(v, data=True):
            ch = data["label"]
            # Follow failure links from v to find failure for child
            x = fail[v]
            while x != "root":
                # Check if x has edge labeled ch
                found = None
                for _, nb, d in G.out_edges(x, data=True):
                    if d["label"] == ch:
                        found = nb
                        break
                if found:
                    fail[child] = found
                    break
                x = fail[x]
            else:
                # Check root
                found = None
                for _, nb, d in G.out_edges("root", data=True):
                    if d["label"] == ch:
                        found = nb
                        break
                fail[child] = found if found and found != child else "root"
            queue.append(child)

    return fail, node_string


def compute_output_links(G, fail):
    """Compute output links: nearest pattern reachable via failure links."""
    from collections import deque
    output = {}
    for n in G.nodes:
        output[n] = None

    # BFS
    queue = deque()
    for _, child in G.out_edges("root"):
        queue.append(child)
        # Check if failure target is a pattern
        f = fail.get(child, "root")
        if f != "root" and G.nodes[f].get("is_leaf", False):
            output[child] = f
        else:
            output[child] = output.get(f)

    while queue:
        v = queue.popleft()
        for _, child in G.out_edges(v):
            f = fail.get(child, "root")
            if f != "root" and G.nodes[f].get("is_leaf", False):
                output[child] = f
            else:
                output[child] = output.get(f)
            queue.append(child)

    return output


def draw_aho_corasick(G, patterns, fail, output, node_string):
    """Draw keyword tree with failure links and output links."""
    pos = hierarchy_pos(G, root="root", width=max(len(G.nodes) * 0.3, 2.0))

    leaves = [n for n in G.nodes if G.nodes[n].get("is_leaf", False)]
    internals = [n for n in G.nodes if n not in leaves]

    depths = [G.nodes[n].get("depth", 0) for n in G.nodes]
    height = max(depths) if depths else 0

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(max(len(G.nodes) * 0.8, 8),
                                     max(height * 1.2, 5)))

    # Draw nodes
    nx.draw_networkx_nodes(G, pos, nodelist=internals, ax=ax,
                           node_color="#BBDEFB", node_size=450, edgecolors="#555")
    nx.draw_networkx_nodes(G, pos, nodelist=leaves, ax=ax,
                           node_color="#FFCC80", node_size=450, edgecolors="#E65100",
                           linewidths=2.0)

    # Tree edges
    nx.draw_networkx_edges(G, pos, ax=ax, edge_color="#777",
                           arrows=True, arrowsize=12, width=1.5)

    # Edge labels
    edge_labels = {(u, v): d["label"] for u, v, d in G.edges(data=True)}
    nx.draw_networkx_edge_labels(G, pos, edge_labels=edge_labels, ax=ax,
                                  font_size=12, font_color="#9C27B0",
                                  font_family="monospace")

    # Failure links (red dashed)
    fail_edges = []
    for n, f in fail.items():
        if n != "root" and f != "root":
            fail_edges.append((n, f))
    if fail_edges:
        nx.draw_networkx_edges(G, pos, edgelist=fail_edges, ax=ax,
                               edge_color="#C62828", style="dashed",
                               arrows=True, arrowsize=10, width=1.5,
                               connectionstyle="arc3,rad=0.3", alpha=0.7)

    # Output links (green dotted)
    out_edges = []
    for n, o in output.items():
        if o is not None:
            out_edges.append((n, o))
    if out_edges:
        nx.draw_networkx_edges(G, pos, edgelist=out_edges, ax=ax,
                               edge_color="#2E7D32", style="dotted",
                               arrows=True, arrowsize=10, width=2.5,
                               connectionstyle="arc3,rad=-0.3", alpha=0.8)

    # Node labels (string spelled)
    for n in G.nodes:
        x, y = pos[n]
        s = node_string.get(n, "")
        if G.nodes[n].get("is_leaf", False):
            pat = G.nodes[n].get("pattern", s)
            ax.text(x, y - 0.35, pat, ha="center", va="top",
                    fontsize=9, fontstyle="italic", color="#E65100",
                    fontfamily="monospace")
        elif n != "root" and s:
            ax.text(x, y + 0.3, s, ha="center", va="bottom",
                    fontsize=7, color="#666", fontfamily="monospace")

    # Root label
    rx, ry = pos["root"]
    ax.text(rx, ry + 0.3, "root", ha="center", va="bottom",
            fontsize=9, color="#999")

    # Legend
    ax.plot([], [], color="#777", linewidth=1.5, label="tree edge")
    ax.plot([], [], color="#C62828", linewidth=1.5, linestyle="dashed",
            label="failure link")
    ax.plot([], [], color="#2E7D32", linewidth=2.5, linestyle="dotted",
            label="output link")
    ax.legend(loc="upper right", fontsize=9, framealpha=0.9)

    ax.set_title(f'Aho-Corasick automaton for {{{", ".join(patterns)}}}',
                 fontsize=13, pad=12)
    ax.axis("off")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

## Aho-Corasick Search — Step by Step

Watch the automaton process the text character by character. At each step:

- **Blue** node = current position in the automaton
- **Red dashed** arrow = failure link followed (when the descent gets stuck)
- **Green** nodes = patterns reported (via direct match or output link chain)

```{pyodide}
#| autorun: true
#| edit: false
#| output: false

def ac_search_trace(T, patterns):
    """Trace Aho-Corasick search step by step."""
    G = build_keyword_tree(patterns)
    fail, node_string = compute_failure_links(G)
    output = compute_output_links(G, fail)

    def get_child(node, ch):
        for _, nb, data in G.out_edges(node, data=True):
            if data["label"] == ch:
                return nb
        return None

    snapshots = []
    w = "root"
    all_matches = []

    for c in range(len(T)):
        ch = T[c]
        failure_chain = []  # nodes visited via failure links
        old_w = w

        # Follow failure links until we can advance
        while w != "root" and get_child(w, ch) is None:
            failure_chain.append(w)
            w = fail.get(w, "root")

        child = get_child(w, ch)
        if child is not None:
            w = child
        # else: w stays at root

        # Collect matches at w
        matches_here = []
        if G.nodes[w].get("is_leaf", False):
            pat = G.nodes[w].get("pattern", node_string.get(w, ""))
            matches_here.append((w, pat))

        # Follow output links
        u = output.get(w)
        output_chain = []
        while u is not None:
            pat = G.nodes[u].get("pattern", node_string.get(u, ""))
            matches_here.append((u, pat))
            output_chain.append(u)
            u = output.get(u)

        for node, pat in matches_here:
            all_matches.append((c - len(pat) + 1, pat))

        snapshots.append({
            "c": c,
            "char": ch,
            "w_before": old_w,
            "w_after": w,
            "failure_chain": failure_chain,
            "output_chain": output_chain,
            "matches_here": [(n, p) for n, p in matches_here],
            "all_matches": list(all_matches),
        })

    return G, fail, output, node_string, snapshots


def draw_ac_search_step(T, G, fail, output, node_string, snapshots, step_idx):
    """Draw one step of AC search."""
    snap = snapshots[step_idx]
    c = snap["c"]
    w = snap["w_after"]
    w_before = snap["w_before"]
    failure_chain = snap["failure_chain"]
    output_chain = snap["output_chain"]
    matches_here = snap["matches_here"]

    pos = hierarchy_pos(G, root="root", width=max(len(G.nodes) * 0.3, 2.0))
    depths = [G.nodes[n].get("depth", 0) for n in G.nodes]
    height = max(depths) if depths else 0

    fig, (ax_text, ax_tree) = plt.subplots(
        2, 1, figsize=(max(len(T) * 0.85, 10), max(height * 1.3 + 2, 6)),
        gridspec_kw={"height_ratios": [1, 3]})

    # ── Text row ──
    ax_text.set_xlim(-2.5, len(T) + 1.5)
    ax_text.set_ylim(-0.5, 2.5)
    ax_text.set_aspect("equal")
    ax_text.axis("off")

    for i in range(len(T)):
        ax_text.text(i + 0.45, 2.2, str(i), ha="center", fontsize=8, color="#999")

    t_hi = {}
    # Highlight matched pattern spans
    for start, pat in snap["all_matches"]:
        for j in range(len(pat)):
            if start + j < len(T):
                t_hi[start + j] = COLORS["match"]
    # Current character
    t_hi[c] = "#42A5F5"  # blue
    draw_string_row(ax_text, 0.8, T, label="T", highlights=t_hi)

    ax_text.annotate(f"c={c}", xy=(c + 0.45, 0.8), xytext=(c + 0.45, 0.15),
                     fontsize=10, color="#1565C0", ha="center", fontweight="bold",
                     arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color="#1565C0", lw=1.5))

    # Event text
    if matches_here:
        match_names = ", ".join([p for _, p in matches_here])
        event = f"MATCH: {match_names}"
        ev_color = COLORS["match"]
    elif failure_chain:
        event = f"failure link{'s' if len(failure_chain) > 1 else ''}: " + \
                " → ".join([node_string.get(n, "?") or "ε" for n in failure_chain] +
                           [node_string.get(w, "?") or "ε"])
        ev_color = "#C62828"
    else:
        event = f"advance to '{node_string.get(w, '')}'"
        ev_color = "#555"

    ax_text.set_title(
        f"Step {step_idx+1}/{len(snapshots)} | T[{c}]='{T[c]}' | "
        f"total matches: {len(snap['all_matches'])}\n{event}",
        fontsize=10, pad=8, color=ev_color)

    # ── Tree ──
    # Highlight sets
    active_nodes = {w}
    match_nodes = set(n for n, _ in matches_here)
    fail_nodes = set(failure_chain)

    for n in G.nodes:
        x, y = pos[n]
        if n in match_nodes:
            color = "#66BB6A"
            ec = "#2E7D32"
            size = 500
        elif n == w:
            color = "#42A5F5"
            ec = "#1565C0"
            size = 500
        elif n in fail_nodes:
            color = "#FFCDD2"
            ec = "#C62828"
            size = 400
        else:
            is_leaf = G.nodes[n].get("is_leaf", False)
            color = "#FFCC80" if is_leaf else "#E8E8E8"
            ec = "#E65100" if is_leaf else "#CCC"
            size = 350

        ax_tree.scatter(x, y, s=size, c=color, edgecolors=ec,
                        linewidths=2.0 if n in active_nodes | match_nodes else 1.0,
                        zorder=5, alpha=1.0 if n in active_nodes | match_nodes | fail_nodes else 0.5)

    # Tree edges
    for u, v, data in G.edges(data=True):
        x1, y1 = pos[u]
        x2, y2 = pos[v]
        alpha = 0.3 if (u not in active_nodes | fail_nodes and
                        v not in active_nodes | fail_nodes) else 0.8
        ax_tree.annotate("", xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                         arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", color="#777",
                                         lw=1.5, alpha=alpha))
        mx, my = (x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2
        ax_tree.text(mx + 0.08, my + 0.08, data["label"],
                     fontsize=11, color="#9C27B0", fontfamily="monospace",
                     alpha=alpha, ha="center")

    # Failure links used in this step
    for fn in failure_chain:
        if fn in pos and fail.get(fn, "root") in pos:
            target = fail[fn]
            x1, y1 = pos[fn]
            x2, y2 = pos[target]
            ax_tree.annotate("", xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", color="#C62828",
                                             lw=2.5, linestyle="dashed",
                                             connectionstyle="arc3,rad=0.3"))

    # Output links used
    for on in output_chain:
        if w in pos and on in pos:
            x1, y1 = pos[w]
            x2, y2 = pos[on]
            ax_tree.annotate("", xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", color="#2E7D32",
                                             lw=2.5, linestyle="dotted",
                                             connectionstyle="arc3,rad=-0.3"))

    # Node labels
    for n in G.nodes:
        x, y = pos[n]
        s = node_string.get(n, "")
        if n == "root":
            ax_tree.text(x, y + 0.3, "root", ha="center", va="bottom",
                         fontsize=8, color="#999")
        elif G.nodes[n].get("is_leaf", False):
            pat = G.nodes[n].get("pattern", s)
            ax_tree.text(x, y - 0.3, pat, ha="center", va="top",
                         fontsize=8, fontstyle="italic", color="#E65100",
                         fontfamily="monospace")
        elif s:
            ax_tree.text(x, y + 0.25, s, ha="center", va="bottom",
                         fontsize=7, color="#666", fontfamily="monospace")

    ax_tree.axis("off")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof T_ac_search = Inputs.text({
  label: "T:",
  value: "ushers",
  width: 500
})
viewof P_ac_search = Inputs.text({
  label: "Patterns (comma-separated):",
  value: "he, she, his, hers",
  width: 500
})
```

```{pyodide}
#| autorun: true
#| edit: false
#| output: false
#| input: [T_ac_search, P_ac_search]
#| define: [ac_max_step]

ac_max_step = 0
if T_ac_search and P_ac_search:
    _pats_acs = [p.strip() for p in P_ac_search.split(",") if p.strip()]
    if _pats_acs:
        ac_max_step = max(len(T_ac_search) - 1, 0)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof step_ac = Inputs.range([0, ac_max_step], {step: 1, value: 0, label: "Step:"})
```

```{pyodide}
#| autorun: true
#| edit: false
#| input: [T_ac_search, P_ac_search, step_ac]

if T_ac_search and P_ac_search:
    _pats_acs = [p.strip() for p in P_ac_search.split(",") if p.strip()]
    if _pats_acs:
        _G_acs, _fail_acs, _out_acs, _nstr_acs, _snaps_acs = ac_search_trace(T_ac_search, _pats_acs)
        draw_ac_search_step(T_ac_search, _G_acs, _fail_acs, _out_acs, _nstr_acs, _snaps_acs, int(step_ac))
```
